wire.session_status.retired_label.role: Sidebar/picker row status label (a plain-text suffix) for a session whose turn was cut by a build update
wire.session_status.retired_label.note: EN-only context sidecar. {base} is the row's ALREADY-composed status word (currently `Interrupted`), inserted verbatim; the suffix after the em dash names the cause (the app retired the turn to update; the operator did not stop it). One logical line: keep the cause short.

wire.session_status.interrupted.note: Complete backend-composed sidebar/picker terminal status; rendered verbatim in desktop feed and TUI. One logical line, no fixed cell cap. Unseen means not yet read, not a new failure. Never insert an English base label or stored diagnostic.

wire.session_status.approval_needed.note: EN-only context sidecar. Live sidebar/picker row status label, composed by the backend (session/catalog.py CatalogEntry.status) and rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar title/sr-only, the status feed, the mobile relay and the TUI sidebar. One logical line, no fixed cell cap. The session is paused on a tool approval the user must grant or deny. Highest-priority rung: the user needs to act.

wire.session_status.answer_needed.note: EN-only context sidecar. Live sidebar/picker row status label, composed by the backend (session/catalog.py CatalogEntry.status) and rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar title/sr-only, the status feed, the mobile relay and the TUI sidebar. One logical line, no fixed cell cap. The session is paused on a question the agent asked the user. Highest-priority rung: the user needs to reply.

wire.session_status.wedged.note: EN-only context sidecar. Live sidebar/picker row status label, composed by the backend (session/catalog.py CatalogEntry.status) and rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar title/sr-only, the status feed, the mobile relay and the TUI sidebar. One logical line, no fixed cell cap. The session's owner process still exists but its heartbeat went stale. Say 'not answering' (what was observed), NOT 'not responding'/'frozen'/'dead': a stale beat does not prove the process stopped. The middle dot separates the two facts; keep it. Used when no heartbeat age was measured.

wire.session_status.wedged_heartbeat.note: EN-only context sidecar. Live sidebar/picker row status label, composed by the backend (session/catalog.py CatalogEntry.status) and rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar title/sr-only, the status feed, the mobile relay and the TUI sidebar. One logical line, no fixed cell cap. Same state as wire.session_status.wedged, plus the measured heartbeat age. {duration} is an already-localized compact duration such as `4m` or `1h 5m`, rendered from the wire.session_status.duration_* keys in the same language and inserted verbatim; translate those keys, not this placeholder. Keep the 'process alive' qualifier: it stops readers inferring the process died.

wire.session_status.working.note: EN-only context sidecar. Live sidebar/picker row status label, composed by the backend (session/catalog.py CatalogEntry.status) and rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar title/sr-only, the status feed, the mobile relay and the TUI sidebar. One logical line, no fixed cell cap. The session's agent turn is running right now. Generic busy state.

wire.session_status.attached.note: EN-only context sidecar. Live sidebar/picker row status label, composed by the backend (session/catalog.py CatalogEntry.status) and rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar title/sr-only, the status feed, the mobile relay and the TUI sidebar. One logical line, no fixed cell cap. The session is open (attached) in a live window or terminal, but not running a turn. Means 'open in a window', not 'unlocked' or 'available'.

wire.session_status.ready.note: EN-only context sidecar. Live sidebar/picker row status label, composed by the backend (session/catalog.py CatalogEntry.status) and rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar title/sr-only, the status feed, the mobile relay and the TUI sidebar. One logical line, no fixed cell cap. The session's runtime is idle and waiting for the user's next message.

wire.session_status.exec_headless.note: EN-only context sidecar. Live sidebar/picker row status label, composed by the backend (session/catalog.py CatalogEntry.status) and rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar title/sr-only, the status feed, the mobile relay and the TUI sidebar. One logical line, no fixed cell cap. An idle one-shot `lop exec` run started by a supervisor, without a UI. Keep `exec` verbatim (it is the command name) inside the parentheses.

wire.session_status.waiting.note: EN-only context sidecar. Live sidebar/picker row status label, composed by the backend (session/catalog.py CatalogEntry.status) and rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar title/sr-only, the status feed, the mobile relay and the TUI sidebar. One logical line, no fixed cell cap. The turn is blocked waiting on background jobs it started. {jobs} is the job count (always >= 1); use locale plural rules.

wire.session_status.waiting_subagents.note: EN-only context sidecar. Live sidebar/picker row status label, composed by the backend (session/catalog.py CatalogEntry.status) and rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar title/sr-only, the status feed, the mobile relay and the TUI sidebar. One logical line, no fixed cell cap. As wire.session_status.waiting, plus subagents (delegated child agents) still running. {jobs} >= 1 and {subagents} >= 1; use locale plural rules for each. 'Subagent' is the product's term for a delegated child agent, not an agent profile. The middle dot separates the two facts; keep it.

wire.session_status.delegating_jobs.note: EN-only context sidecar. Live sidebar/picker row status label, composed by the backend (session/catalog.py CatalogEntry.status) and rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar title/sr-only, the status feed, the mobile relay and the TUI sidebar. One logical line, no fixed cell cap. One segment of a delegating row: the parent's own turn is NOT running, but background jobs it owns are. {count} >= 1; locale plural rules. Segments are joined by ' · ' in the order jobs, running subagents, queued; each segment must stand alone as a phrase.

wire.session_status.delegating_running.note: EN-only context sidecar. Live sidebar/picker row status label, composed by the backend (session/catalog.py CatalogEntry.status) and rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar title/sr-only, the status feed, the mobile relay and the TUI sidebar. One logical line, no fixed cell cap. One segment of a delegating row: subagents (delegated child agents) still running while the parent's own turn is not. {count} >= 1; locale plural rules. Joined to other segments by ' · '; must stand alone as a phrase. Do not phrase as the parent 'delegating' or acting.

wire.session_status.delegating_queued.note: EN-only context sidecar. Live sidebar/picker row status label, composed by the backend (session/catalog.py CatalogEntry.status) and rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar title/sr-only, the status feed, the mobile relay and the TUI sidebar. One logical line, no fixed cell cap. One segment of a delegating row, used when NO subagent is running: subagents parked waiting for capacity. {count} >= 1; locale plural rules. Must not read as idle. Joined to other segments by ' · '.

wire.session_status.delegating_queued_ad.note: EN-only context sidecar. Live sidebar/picker row status label, composed by the backend (session/catalog.py CatalogEntry.status) and rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar title/sr-only, the status feed, the mobile relay and the TUI sidebar. One logical line, no fixed cell cap. Short segment that FOLLOWS the running-subagents segment (wire.session_status.delegating_running) after ' · ', e.g. `2 subagents running · 1 queued`; the noun is implied by that preceding segment. {count} >= 1 subagents waiting for capacity; plural forms are provided so the adjective can agree.

wire.session_status.duration_seconds.role: Compact duration unit inside a live row status label
wire.session_status.duration_seconds.note: EN-only context sidecar. One arm of the compact elapsed-time value inserted as {duration} into wire.session_status.wedged_heartbeat (session/catalog.py status_duration); it is never shown on its own. Live sidebar/picker row status rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar, status feed, mobile relay and TUI sidebar, so keep it as short as the English: a number plus a one- or two-letter unit abbreviation, no plural words, no trailing punctuation. Use the locale's conventional short unit abbreviation (or keep the ASCII letter if that is the norm). {count} is whole seconds, 0-59. English `42s`.

wire.session_status.duration_minutes.role: Compact duration unit inside a live row status label
wire.session_status.duration_minutes.note: EN-only context sidecar. One arm of the compact elapsed-time value inserted as {duration} into wire.session_status.wedged_heartbeat (session/catalog.py status_duration); it is never shown on its own. Live sidebar/picker row status rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar, status feed, mobile relay and TUI sidebar, so keep it as short as the English: a number plus a one- or two-letter unit abbreviation, no plural words, no trailing punctuation. Use the locale's conventional short unit abbreviation (or keep the ASCII letter if that is the norm). {count} is whole minutes, 1-59. English `4m`.

wire.session_status.duration_hours_minut.role: Compact duration unit inside a live row status label
wire.session_status.duration_hours_minut.note: EN-only context sidecar. One arm of the compact elapsed-time value inserted as {duration} into wire.session_status.wedged_heartbeat (session/catalog.py status_duration); it is never shown on its own. Live sidebar/picker row status rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar, status feed, mobile relay and TUI sidebar, so keep it as short as the English: a number plus a one- or two-letter unit abbreviation, no plural words, no trailing punctuation. Use the locale's conventional short unit abbreviation (or keep the ASCII letter if that is the norm). {hours} is 1-23 and {minutes} is 0-59 (a zero minute part is still shown). English `3h 12m`; keep both parts in one token-like group.

wire.session_status.duration_days_hours.role: Compact duration unit inside a live row status label
wire.session_status.duration_days_hours.note: EN-only context sidecar. One arm of the compact elapsed-time value inserted as {duration} into wire.session_status.wedged_heartbeat (session/catalog.py status_duration); it is never shown on its own. Live sidebar/picker row status rendered verbatim in the desktop sidebar, status feed, mobile relay and TUI sidebar, so keep it as short as the English: a number plus a one- or two-letter unit abbreviation, no plural words, no trailing punctuation. Use the locale's conventional short unit abbreviation (or keep the ASCII letter if that is the norm). {days} is a whole number of days (1 or more, unbounded) passed as a pre-rendered ASCII digit string so it never gains a grouping separator (English `1000d`, not `1,000d`); insert it verbatim. {hours} is 0-23. English `2d 4h`.
